query:
UPDATE shaders SET
                name = COALESCE($1, name),
                description = COALESCE($2, description),
                modrinth_id = COALESCE($3, modrinth_id),
                curseforge_id = COALESCE($4, curseforge_id),
                website_url = COALESCE($5, website_url),
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE id = $6
